user.title: Set up HAMediaConnect
user.description: Add the integration to Home Assistant so Android devices can securely register as media players.

abort.unsupported_ha_version: HAMediaConnect requires Home Assistant Core {required_version} or newer. This server is running {current_version}. Upgrade Home Assistant Core and restart Home Assistant, then add the integration again.

unsupported_ha_version.title: Home Assistant Core upgrade required
unsupported_ha_version.description: HAMediaConnect requires Home Assistant Core {required_version} or newer. This server is running {current_version}. Upgrade Home Assistant Core and restart Home Assistant to enable HAMediaConnect. The integration will not start on this version because secure OAuth requires S256 PKCE support.
